create_training_config: create a Training pydantic model to configure the training regime with timeout, episodes, and benchmarks
iterate_benchmarks: iterate over training benchmarks by calling benchmarks_iterator on a Training instance with a CompilerEnv
iterate_benchmark_uris: iterate over training benchmark URIs by calling benchmark_uris_iterator on a Training instance with a CompilerEnv
wrap_environment: wrap a CompilerEnv for the training loop using wrap_env to cycle over benchmarks on each reset call
configure_benchmark_caching: configure benchmark caching behavior by setting cache_benchmarks and cycle_over_benchmarks on a Training instance
